finding.summary: Phase attribution of the bulk prefill: the sharded MLP exchange plus its f32->bf16 cast costs 1.94 ms/layer, which consumes 67% of the 2.90 ms/layer the MLP sharding saves. Replicated attention/GDN is 42% of the wall and the shard chain 34%.
finding.model_check: attention + norm + chain + exch + cast, x64 layers = 537 ms against a measured 540 ms wall; the same model for the single-card route (full 2x chain, no exchange) gives 599 ms against its measured 574.8 ms
finding.sharding_economics: halving the MLP saves 2.90 ms/layer; exchange+cast costs 1.94 ms/layer; net 0.96 ms/layer, so TP2 leads TP1 by only 6% measured

levers.exchange_and_cast: 23% of the wall; the cost is PCIe traffic, 10.5 MB D2H plus a 10.5 MB zero-copy read of the f32 payload from pinned host memory for the cast
levers.replicated_attention_gdn: 42% of the wall, halving it would save 21%

finding.target: a batched device-side reduction (the decode route already has a rows=1 peer-spin device exchange with bit-identical gates) removes the host sum, the f32 PCIe read-back and the cast kernel
